findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed two sanitizer buckets in the facility measure 0ppm quaternary ammonia with a test strip. The PIC was informed and the buckets were replaced. Ensure sanitizer buckets are tested and replaced frequently to guarantee proper sanitization. If buckets are consistently measuring 0ppm before replacement time, the frequency of replace needs to be increased.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Personal cleanliness.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an employee handling food without a proper hair restraint. The PIC was informed that restraints are required to prevent cross-contamination. Ensure all employees have their hair restrained prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 2-402.11 Effectiveness. (A) Except as provided in (B) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES shall wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings or nets, beard restraints, and clothing that covers body hair, that are designed and worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed FOOD; clean EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, and LINENS; and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the interior of the tray warmers to be soiled with food debris. Clean the interior of the warmers to prevent cross-contamination. Inspector also observed the hood above the fryers to be soiled. Ensure hood system is cleaned by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation - Observed standing water in the dry storage room. The water was not in contact with food items stored in the room. The PIC stated that rain water is encroaching from the exterior wall. PIC plans to schedule service to have the exterior wall repaired. Ensure exterior walls are in good repair to prevent the encroachment of contaminated water into the facility. In the meantime, ensure water is cleaned off floor when encroachment occurs. 

Repeat Violation - Observed considerable ice accumulation at the walk-in freezer door and above the fans in the walk-in freezer. Ensure walk-in freezer is in good repair to prevent the accumulation of ice.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed the back hand sink to be obstructed by boxes on the floor surrounding the sink. Ensure the hand sink is accessible at all times. The items around the hand sink were moved during the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.
